      "computation_change_reason": "This row states the enforceable pH numeric bounds, required measurement frequency, and sample type for Outfall 001; different readings of the dual min/max limits, the Five/Week (*1) frequency, or Grab sampling would change compliance comparisons and whether monitoring was required."

      "source": "farmington/final_permit.pdf",

      "computation_change_reason": "The minimum pH bound is the lower enforceable numeric limit used for compliance comparison; a different interpretation of units, rounding, or instantaneous versus averaging basis would change exceedance determinations."
